  1769→    /// Common finalization logic for both BlockSTM and BlockSTMv2 parallel execution.
  1770→    /// Handles commit task validation, error checking, state updates, and cleanup.
  1771→    fn finalize_parallel_execution(
  1772→        &self,
  1773→        shared_maybe_error: &AtomicBool,
  1774→        has_remaining_commit_tasks: bool,
  1775→        final_results: ExplicitSyncWrapper<Vec<E::Output>>,
  1776→        block_limit_processor: ExplicitSyncWrapper<BlockGasLimitProcessor<T, S>>,
  1777→        block_epilogue_txn: Option<Transaction>,
  1778→        mut versioned_cache: MVHashMap<T::Key, T::Tag, T::Value, DelayedFieldID>,
  1779→        scheduler: impl Send + 'static,
  1780→        last_input_output: TxnLastInputOutput<T, E::Output, E::Error>,
  1781→        module_cache_manager_guard: &mut AptosModuleCacheManagerGuard,
  1782→    ) -> Result<BlockOutput<T::Key, E::Output>, ()> {
  1783→        // Check for errors or remaining commit tasks before any side effects.
  1784→        let mut has_error = shared_maybe_error.load(Ordering::SeqCst);
  1785→        if !has_error && has_remaining_commit_tasks {
  1786→            alert!("[BlockSTM]: commit tasks not drained after parallel execution");
  1787→            shared_maybe_error.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
  1788→            has_error = true;
  1789→        }
  1790→
  1791→        if has_error {
  1792→            // Does not hurt to asynchronously drop even in the error case.
  1793→            DEFAULT_DROPPER.schedule_drop((last_input_output, scheduler, versioned_cache));
  1794→
  1795→            return Err(());
  1796→        }
  1797→
  1798→        // Update state counters & insert verified modules into cache (safe after error check).
  1799→        counters::update_state_counters(versioned_cache.stats(), true);
  1800→        module_cache_manager_guard
  1801→            .module_cache_mut()
  1802→            .insert_verified(versioned_cache.take_modules_iter())
  1803→            .map_err(|err| {
  1804→                alert!("[BlockSTM] Encountered panic error: {:?}", err);
  1805→            })?;
